processing.cropMethod: Manually reviewed candidate regions, then alpha-tight bounds with a 2px internal safety margin.
processing.transparency: Original sheets retain native alpha; no black-background keying was applied.
processing.alignment: Canvas shared by animation/direction; visual content horizontally centered and bottom-aligned with a 4px pad.
processing.overlapHandling: Closely composed hero-jump and competitor poses use the largest connected alpha silhouette from their reviewed region, preventing adjacent-pose fragments from being exported.

auditNotes: Competidores_Corrida contains authored idle, right-running, up-running, and hit poses for each competitor.
No distinct left-running or down-running competitor source poses were present; they were not fabricated or exported.
Titles, direction labels, and explanatory sheet UI were intentionally excluded from all frame candidates.
